main_text.p: nim[?], الا قاتلهم علي بالنهروان مقاتلة شديدة فلا، ادغلتن منهم الا اقل من عشرة فما قتل من المسلمين اقل من عشرة فاذهزم اثنان منهم الي عمان واثنان الي كرمان واثنان الي سجستان واثنان الي الجزيرة واحد الي قل موريون بالبمن وظهرت ببدع الخوارج في هذه المواضع منهم وبقيت الي اليوم Attri cos[?]

certamine aggressus est Ali in Nahrawan, adeo ut non evaderent ex ipsis nisi pauciores decem, cum ex Orthodoxis qui occiderentur infra decem essent. Fugerunt autem ex iis duo in Ommanum duo in Carmaniam, duo in Sejestanum, & duo in Jazirah, unus autem ad Tel Maurun in Yaman, atque inde orta est Charejiorum hæresis quæ iisdem in locis, ad hunc usque diem permansit. Sectæ eorum complures, quarum tamen præcipuæ, præter Mobaccemios jam dictos sex sunt, (cæteræ earum furculi) quæ licet aliis in rebus multum inter se discrepent, tamen جمعهم القوم بالتبرى de عن عثمان وعلي ويقدمون ذلك علي كل طاعة ولا يصححون المناكحات الا علي ذلك ويكفرون اصحاب الكبائر ويرون الخروج علي الامام اذا خالف السنة عقا واجبا Commune hoc est omnibus, ut Othmano & Ali penitus renuntiandum statuant, atque hoc omni cultui præferant, nec alia conditione nuptias contrahere permittant, & pro infidelibus habeant peccatorum gravissimorum reos, & necessarium putent Antichristi cum legem transgressus fuerit se opponere. Multum

page.notes: Arabic lines are transcribed as far as legible; the exact letters of several words in the Arabic (e.g. ببدع, الجزيرة, جمعهم القوم بالتبرى, and the final words of the Arabic block) are doubtful and should be checked against the scan. The word "nim" at the start of the first Arabic line is set in italic and could be the end of a Latin word from the previous page; it is marked [?]. "Attri cos" at the end of the first Arabic block is uncertain. The Latin text is italic in the scan. A word in the Arabic line near "tamen" appears to be a Latin or mixed insertion, marked as printed.
